title: Evaluation options and gate script
description: WS-06. Proposed additive field JobRequest.options.evaluation (contract change request CCR-06-01) and the gate script object it references. Accepted only from principals holding both release:pin and eval:run (svc_eval-worker, release operators); control-plane-api rejects it with 403 otherwise. Its presence puts the ReplicantJob in evaluation mode (eval-harness.md section 3.3): gates resolve from the script inside the workflow (no Update, no human), notifications are suppressed, and the publish node is skipped (dry_run semantics) for mode=shadow and for mode=eval unless publish_to_eval_git=true. Fix round: harness_task and pipeline_id are added by CCR-06-07 (R1-134, R2-061). Scripts live at s3://<org>-replicant-<env>-eval/runs/<eval_run_id>/case/<golden_task_id>/{gate-script.json,review-rounds.json}; replicant-worker may read only runs/*/case/* (R1-143).

gate_script_uri.description: s3:// URI (eval bucket for mode=eval; tenant artifacts bucket under the shadow job's prefix for mode=shadow) of a GateScript document. Required for mode=eval.

memory_snapshot_id.description: Pre-created memory snapshot to use instead of creating one at context assembly, so that both arms of a comparison see identical memory when their snapshot policies are equal.

memory_replay_job_id.description: C-JOBREQ evaluation_options field from CCR-04-05 (accepted): the source job whose recorded memory injections and pull results this eval job replays exactly (eval-harness.md memory replay). Valid only with mode=eval and memory_snapshot_id, which must equal the source job's snapshot; memory-service verifies.

memory_scope_context.description: For mode=eval: the scope the snapshot emulates (the golden task's source tenant and repo), so retrieval behaves as it would for the original job. memory-service authorizes svc_eval-worker for read-only snapshot creation in that scope (WS-04 dependency XD-06-04).

shadow_of_job_id.description: Required for mode=shadow: the live job being shadowed.

publish_to_eval_git.description: mode=eval only: allow the publish node to push to the eval Git server (git.eval.<env>.replicant.internal) to exercise the publisher path. Default false.

harness_task.description: CCR-06-07 (R1-134): mode=eval only. The ReplicantJob skips the router and graph and runs only the harness steps for this kind (eval-harness.md §3.8). Runs use role eval and are owned by this job's workflow, so its Runner-call activity signs the run grants.

spec_uri.description: s3:// URI of the harness spec in the eval bucket under runs/<eval_run_id>/case/… (score), runs/<eval_run_id>/snapshot/… or runs/<eval_run_id>/compat/…; lists the steps and the precomputed inputs manifests.

pipeline_id.description: CCR-06-07 (R2-061): mode=shadow: the ReleasePipeline whose gateway budget account (fgw:pipeline:<pipeline_id>) pays for the job; control-plane-api registers the job with that account at intake.

GateScript.description: Read by the workflow's evaluation-mode gate resolver (WS-01 implements; activity eval.read_gate_script). Each gate that opens is resolved by the first matching rule; unmatched gates resolve per 'default'. The workflow emits timeline event 'gate.auto_resolved' with the rule index, so scoring can check expected gates (D11).

ordinal.description: Match only the n-th opening of this gate kind (1-based). Absent = every opening.

decision.description: stop_case closes the gate as cancelled with no decision object and no approval record, and ends the job cancelled (reason eval_stop_case); the case is scored resolved=false (R1-143).

review_rounds_key.description: Key (eval bucket) of a ReviewRounds document: runs/<eval_run_id>/case/<golden_task_id>/review-rounds.json. Activity eval.read_review_round(k) maps round k to the feedback batch the await_pr_feedback step builds from pr.event Signals (eval-harness.md §3.3).

rules.comment: Keep the change inside internal/proration; do not touch the public API.

rules.answer_text: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) to two decimal places.
